methodologySteps.title: Understand Concept
methodologySteps.description: Deconstruct the real-world utility and intuition behind the algorithmic idea before examining syntax.

methodologySteps.title: Visualize on Paper
methodologySteps.description: Draw out node transitions, pointer manipulations, and array mutations using visual diagrams.

methodologySteps.title: Write Clean Code
methodologySteps.description: Translate the visual intuition into clear, modular C++ code utilizing appropriate STL data containers.

methodologySteps.title: Dry Run on Example
methodologySteps.description: Manually trace variable state changes step-by-step to verify correctness and uncover hidden logic oversights.

methodologySteps.title: Optimize Complexity
methodologySteps.description: Analyze Big-O runtime and memory footprints to transform brute-force solutions into highly efficient algorithms.

methodologySteps.title: Practice Problems
methodologySteps.description: Reinforce conceptual grasp by tackling a curated set of variations across increasing difficulty tiers.

methodologySteps.title: Interview Questions
methodologySteps.description: Test your reflexes under time limits against authentic interview problem formulations from top technology companies.

methodologySteps.title: Periodic Revision
methodologySteps.description: Utilize spaced repetition to solidify pattern recognition and long-term algorithmic recall without memorization.

roadmapSteps.title: Programming Basics & Logic
roadmapSteps.description: Variables, conditional control flow, loops, functions, and fundamental algorithmic logic.

roadmapSteps.title: C++ Syntax & Pointers
roadmapSteps.description: Memory addresses, dynamic allocation, references, and deep comprehension of pointer arithmetic.

roadmapSteps.title: Arrays, Strings & Two-Pointers
roadmapSteps.description: Linear traversal optimization, sliding window techniques, and multi-directional pointer strategies.

roadmapSteps.title: Linked Lists & Linear Structures
roadmapSteps.description: Singly and doubly linked lists, reversal techniques, Floyd's slow/fast cycle finding, and memory management.

roadmapSteps.title: Stacks, Queues & Hash Maps
roadmapSteps.description: Monotonic stack evaluation, breadth-first simulation, and instant constant-time lookups via hash mapping.

roadmapSteps.title: Trees, BST & Heaps
roadmapSteps.description: Recursive branching structures, binary search tree invariants, heap property balance, and level traversals.

roadmapSteps.title: Graph Theory & Algorithms
roadmapSteps.description: Adjacency representation, BFS, DFS, Dijkstra's shortest path, cycle detection, and topological sorting.

roadmapSteps.title: Recursion, DP & Interview Preparation
roadmapSteps.description: Subproblem decomposition, tabular Dynamic Programming, state exploration, and mock technical interviews.
